facts.text: Audrey expressed that dogs bring her a lot of joy and she cannot get bored.

evidence.quote: Yep! They bring me so much joy. Can't get bored at all.

facts.text: Audrey shared a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouth.

evidence.quote: [image: a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouth]

facts.text: Andrew commented that the dogs look adorable playing in the park and that seeing them have fun is rewarding.

evidence.quote: Aww, they look adorable playing in the park! Seeing them have so much fun must be so rewarding.

facts.text: Audrey confirmed that seeing the dogs happy and bouncy makes her really happy.

evidence.quote: Yeah it sure does. Seeing them so happy and bouncy makes me really happy.
